title: UAE Central Bank Payment Token Services Regulation moves into operational phase
summary: The Central Bank of the UAE's Payment Token Services Regulation, which licenses and supervises the issuance, conversion, custody and transfer of fiat-referenced payment tokens including stablecoins, moved out of its transition period on 16 June 2026 and is now in its operational phase.
description: The regulation gives UAE-licensed payment token issuers and service providers a formal supervisory framework — a reference point for stablecoin activity in a major Gulf payments hub, with direct relevance to cross-border settlement using tokenised value.
